messages:
maya: Quick design drop: compact spend surface — aim: show token breakdown inline for most users, but keep header < 2 rows. Screenshot: sam: Nice. Concern: legend + sparkline will push header height. Could we collapse legend into an 'i' popover by default? :thinking_face: li: @maya what's the primary task here? glance spend or drill to invoice? need to prioritize. maya: Primary is glance for eng/product teams; second is quick jump-to-invoice/export. If glance then inline token totals, with small chevrons to expand to full breakdown. emily: A11y: popovers need keyboard focus + screen reader label. Don't rely on color alone for categories. Contrast on sparkline low — current palette fails 3:1 for small strokes. sam: Proposal: compact header with 2 rows: left = scope + date, right = spend big number + token denom. Add chevron toggle to expand breakdown. When collapsed show 3-col legend w/ icons. maya: I mocked a state — collapsed vs expanded. Collapsed shows 'Tokens: 1.2M (est $123) ›' Clicking expands panel below. Also an escape-hatch link to 'Open invoice' (primary CTA). sam: Sounds good. For token denom, prefer unit label 'tks' or 'tokens'? We used 'tokens' elsewhere. li: Use 'tokens' for clarity. Also need org vs project toggle — current toggle patterns live in header; we should reuse that component to keep consistency. emily: For screen reader: aria-controls + aria-expanded. example:
...
Make sure expanded state sets hidden attr appropriately and that the toggle moves focus into the panel on expand. sam: Copy nits: 'Estimated spend' vs 'Spend (est.)' — which reads better? li: Prefer 'Estimated spend' (legal also prefers explicit 'estimated'). sam: Microinteraction: animate expand height, but respect reduced-motion preference (prefers-reduced-motion). maya: Edge case: when user selects 'org' scope, breakdown should show project-level sparkline inline for top 3 projects. Could be noisy for large orgs. emily: If organization, consider collapsing project sparklines behind hover or tooltip. Also ensure focus order predictable (don't insert focusable items dynamically before the toggle). sam: Perf: don't render all sparklines server-side; lazy-load via IntersectionObserver and cache results per session. maya: I'll update Figma + attach new screenshot in thread. @li can you confirm invoice CTA placement is fine as primary or should download be secondary? li: Primary = 'Open invoice' (right aligned), secondary = 'Download CSV'. That matches usage we saw in analytics. console-bot: Deploy preview available: https://preview.redwood.ai/compact-spend?pr=4587 sam: :thumbsup: I'll implement the accordion + aria attributes, will ping when PR ready. emily: :eyes: I'll do quick a11y pass once PR is up.
